_source: Mongoose Traveller 2e Core Rulebook Update 2022, printed pp38-39 (pdf 31-32)
name: Noble
blurb: Individuals of the upper class who perform little consistent function but often have large amounts of ready money.
_qualification_note: Noble is the only career with an AUTOMATIC qualification clause: SOC 10 or higher qualifies without a roll. The SOC 10+ check therefore only ever matters for Travellers with SOC 9 or below, who must roll 2D + SOC DM. Steepest entry bar in the book.

assignments.name: Administrator
assignments.desc: You serve in the planetary government or even rule over a fiefdom or other domain.

assignments.name: Diplomat
assignments.desc: You are a diplomat or other state official.

assignments.name: Dilettante
assignments.desc: You are known for being known and have absolutely no useful function in society.

_survival_note: Dilettante is the only assignment in the book whose SURVIVAL roll keys off SOC.
_cash_note: Noble has by far the richest Cash column in the book -- Cr200000 on a 7, against Cr50000 for the Navy.

mishaps.text: Severely injured (as a result of 2 on the Injury table). Alternatively, roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
A family scandal forces you out of your position. Lose one SOC.
A disaster or war strikes. Roll Stealth 8+ or Deception 8+ to escape unhurt; on failure roll on the Injury table.
Political manoeuvrings usurp your position. Increase Diplomat or Advocate by one level and gain a Rival.
An assassin attempts to end your life. Roll END 8+; on failure roll on the Injury table.
Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.text: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table, but you are not ejected from this career.

You are challenged to a duel for your honour and standing. If you refuse, reduce your SOC by 1. If you accept, roll Melee (blade) 8+: on success gain one SOC; on failure roll on the Injury table and reduce your SOC by one. Either way gain one level in Melee (blade), Leadership, Tactics (any) or Deception.
Your time as a ruler or playboy gives you a wide range of experiences. Gain one of Animals (handling) 1, Art 1, Carouse 1 or Streetwise 1.
You inherit a gift from a rich relative. Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.
You become deeply involved in politics on your world of residence, becoming a player in the intrigues of government. Gain one level in Advocate, Admin, Diplomat or Persuade but also gain a Rival.
Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.

A conspiracy of nobles attempts to recruit you. If you refuse, gain the conspiracy as an Enemy. If you accept, roll Deception 8+ or Persuade 8+: on failure roll on the Mishap table as the conspiracy collapses; on success gain one level of Deception, Persuade, Tactics or Carouse.

Your reign is acclaimed by all as fair and wise -- or, as a dilettante, you sponge off your family's wealth a while longer. Gain either a jealous relative or an unhappy subject as an Enemy. Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.
You manipulate and charm your way through high society. Gain one level of Carouse, Diplomat, Persuade or Steward, as well as a Rival and an Ally.
You make an alliance with a powerful and charismatic noble, who becomes an Ally. Either gain one level of Leadership or DM+4 to your next advancement roll thanks to their aid.
Your efforts do not go unnoticed by the Imperium. You are automatically promoted.
